name: allocation-grid
description: Luma/chroma count-vs-precision grid at a fixed AC budget of 202 bits. Because tier m multiplies every count by 4^m at constant bit width, the SAME base allocation lands at 32 B (tier 0) and 108 B (tier 1) - so one grid answers the allocation question at both anchors and shows whether the optimum moves with the budget. Every arm pins the four selection/encoder knobs to their PRE-adoption values so the comparison isolates the layout: §10 adopted aniso=1.2, sel_hv=0.15, scale_fit=2 and ac_nearest=1 as defaults, and an arm that omitted them would silently carry the adopted recipe — which had made the incumbent identical to the L28@4 C15@3 arm it was meant to be measured against.
